title: fix(runtime): POST /api/v1/packages parses the manifest `version` leg instead of installing anything it is handed
body:
Fixes #19120

Clause-②: no (narrowing)

`POST /api/v1/packages` installed a manifest with no `version` and answered `201`, while the published declaration for that door has always required one. The door now parses that leg and refuses loudly.

## What changed

`PackageInstallRequestSchema` binds `manifest: ManifestSchema`, and `ManifestSchema` declares `version` required with a semantic grammar. The door parsed nothing at all — `const manifest = body.manifest || body` went straight to `installPackage`, with an id check as the only gate on the way.

The install branch now asks the declaration **by reference** and refuses with `400` / `VALIDATION_ERROR` plus a prescription naming the key and its shape.

```
ManifestSchema.shape.version.safeParse(manifest?.version)
```

Three properties of that spelling are load-bearing:

- **By reference, not by copy.** The `PATCH /packages/:id` door further down the same file keeps its own hand-written semver regex. A second copy here would be the third judgment of one key on one surface. Because this door asks the declaration, whatever the open version-grammar canon question settles on reaches it with no edit to this file.
- **No new error code.** `deps.error(msg, 400)` derives `VALIDATION_ERROR` from `standardErrorCodeForHttpStatus(400)`, the standard catalog's member for 400 — the same dialect the repeated-query-parameter refusal on this route already answers in. Nothing in `packages/spec` moves, and nothing in it was touched.
- **Ordered ahead of the duplicate-id 409.** A request-shape refusal must not depend on server state. Placed after the 409, one and the same under-specified body would answer `400` or `409` according to whether that id happened to be installed already — two answers to one authoring mistake. The id gate above it still wins, because with no id there is nothing to name in the sentence this gate prints.

## The scope fence held — the five classes are SEPARABLE

The card is graded on the `version` leg alone. The declaration's residual docblock records five classes this door answers `201` to; the dispatch asked whether enforcing `version` forces the other four along.

**It does not.** The structural reading: the five are produced at three different levels — a per-key field schema in `ManifestSchema.shape` (this leg), the union arms' strict close (unknown keys, bare-form options), and this handler's own `=== true` / `=== 'true'` comparisons (the string-typed options). The single call that would close four at once is `PackageInstallBodySchema.safeParse(body)`, and that call is pointedly not made. `ManifestSchema.shape.version` is an independent field schema that parses one value with no reference to any other key or to the envelope.

Measured at this head, after the fix, driving the real door (one-shot probe, not a committed test):

| class | case | status | installed |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1a **version** | wrapped, no `version` | **400** VALIDATION_ERROR | no |
| 1a **version** | bare, no `version` | **400** VALIDATION_ERROR | no |
| 1a **version** | off-spec grammar | **400** VALIDATION_ERROR | no |
| 1b type | wrapped, no `type` | 201 | yes |
| 1b type | bare, no `type` | 201 | yes |
| 2 unknown keys | unknown key, wrapped form | 201 | yes |
| 2 unknown keys | unknown key, inside the manifest | 201 | yes |
| 2 unknown keys | unknown key, bare form | 201 | yes |
| 3 string-typed | `enableOnInstall: 'false'` | 201 (enabled) | yes |
| 3 string-typed | `overwrite: 'true'` on the body | 201 | yes |
| 4 bare-form options | `settings` on the bare form | 201 | yes |
| 5 whitespace id | id of spaces only | 400 (pre-existing) | no |

Only the `version` rows moved. The other four classes are untouched in both directions, and **no committed test asserts anything about them** — pinning them as `201` would freeze four known residuals as intended behaviour and turn the card that closes one of them red for doing its job.

Note for whoever takes the residual next: the docblock's clause 1 reads "a manifest missing `type` and/or `version`", and after this PR only the `type` half of it is still true. That text lives in `packages/spec`, which is the `domain:spec` seat's — flagged in the report, not edited here.

## Tests

`packages/runtime/src/domains/packages-install-manifest-version.test.ts`, 20 cases:

- **§0** asserts each fixture off-spec **by the declaration** before §1 holds the door to it. If the version-grammar canon moves, §0 goes red first and names what happened, instead of §1 failing for a reason a reader has to reconstruct.
- **§1** pins both halves a refusal owes: `400` + `VALIDATION_ERROR` + `success: false` on the wire, **and** that neither install writer was called. A door that answered `400` and installed anyway satisfies a status assertion alone.
- **§2** is the positive control, on both body forms and both install limbs, asserting the manifest reaches `installPackage` unchanged — this is a gate, not a normaliser.
- **§3** pins the ordering, with the 409 itself as the control that the 409 was not simply removed.

**One fixture repaired outside the new file.** `packages/runtime/src/domain-handler-registry.test.ts`'s duplicate-id case drove the door with `{ id: 'pkg-a', name: 'A' }` — a body `ManifestSchema` has never admitted. Its subject is the 409 guard and the `?overwrite=true` bypass, not manifest completeness, so it gets the `version` it never carried. The repair is owed whatever order the new gate sits in: that case's `?overwrite=true` limb asserts `201`, which an under-specified manifest must never reach, so no placement of the gate leaves the fixture valid.

## Verification

Final head `0ccf7296d4`, after `git merge origin/main`.

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime test` — **269 files / 3725 passed**, 1 skipped, exit 0
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime typecheck` — exit 0
- `pnpm --filter '@objectstack/runtime...' build` — exit 0
- **58 of 58** derived gate families run, **0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN** (`dispatch-gates.mjs --ran`, exit codes captured before any pipe). `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` answered `PREREQUISITE NOT MET` on the pre-merge run and measures green here once its build closure existed.
- `pnpm lint` — the **full unnarrowed repo union** (`eslint . --no-inline-config`), exit 0, at this head. Not a narrowed run, so no narrowing is claimed.
- `check-adr-0087-registration` reads the changeset as `[BREAKING+clause-②-narrowing]` carrying `not-required (no-migration-prescription)`.

## Changeset

`minor`, declared breaking. Not `major`: the launch-window guard ships breaking changes as minor while the stack versions in lockstep. The ADR-0087 disposition is `not-required (no-migration-prescription)` — nothing authorable is removed, renamed or reshaped, so `objectstack migrate meta` has nothing to reach; there is no old spelling that maps to a new one, only a key the declaration already required.

## Acceptance notes

- **The residual docblock is now half-stale** and needs the `domain:spec` seat: clause 1 of `PackageInstallBodySchema`'s docblock records `type` and/or `version` as one `201` class, and only `type` remains. Reported, not edited — `packages/spec` is not this card's to touch.
- **The four other residual classes** stay open and each needs its own reading, per triage. Measured unchanged above.
- **The `PATCH /packages/:id` door keeps a hand-copied semver regex.** Correct today and not a defect, so not filed — but it is the copy that has to be found by hand if the version-grammar canon moves, while this door follows the declaration on its own. Noted for whoever takes that canon card.
